What We’re Looking For: 

Geologist 3

Where We Need You

Ohio EPA wants you to serve in this role within the Division of Materials and Waste Management (DMWM) at our Central Office in Columbus, Ohio.

Why We Need You

Ohio EPA is seeking a skilled Geologist to join our team that is helping protect Ohio’s groundwater resources near waste management facilities.

What You'll Do.

In this role, you will evaluate existing and potential sources of groundwater contamination at regulated landfills, construction and demolition debris facilities, and related sites. You’ll review detailed hydrogeologic reports, monitoring plans, water quality data, and engineering designs for accuracy and compliance with applicable rules and regulations.

As part of your field duties, you’ll investigate and research groundwater areas near waste sites to assess environmental impacts. You’ll also collect and interpret groundwater data to respond to complaints and recommend actions to prevent or minimize contamination. Position Overview

The individual is an integral member of a small team furthering the Summer Liberal Arts Institute’s mission to provide an immersive residential pre-college program for motivated high school students looking for a rigorous course experience. Courses and community experiences are intentionally designed to be small, tight-knit, and exploratory for students interested in experiencing a liberal arts learning environment at a top-10 ranked private college. Through SLAI, these pre-college students discover dedicated faculty, supportive peers, and the flexibility to chart their own path through engaging activities and college-level academics.

This individual assists the office’s marketing efforts, co-manages Carleton student workers, orchestrates the competitive Pre-College application process, and coordinates summer program logistics. This individual assists with developing and implementing a comprehensive recruitment and yield strategy. As SLAI’s summer offerings change and expand, the position may take on new responsibilities. Company Description

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries to make life and our environment safer, healthier, and more sustainable.

From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins laboratories work with some of the world's largest organizations to ensure products are safe, authentic, and accurately labeled.

The Eurofins network includes over 58,000 employees across 900 laboratories in more than 54 countries, offering over 200,000 analytical methods supporting pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, food, environmental testing, clinical diagnostics, and more.

Job Description

Eurofins is seeking a detail-oriented and customer-focused Laboratory Project Coordinator
to support the successful execution of laboratory testing projects. This role serves as a key liaison between clients and internal laboratory teams, ensuring projects move efficiently from initiation through completion while maintaining exceptional customer service and accurate documentation.

Essential Responsibilities

Review quotations, purchase orders, protocols, methods, specifications, client instructions, and related documentation to ensure project requirements are accurately captured.
Create, maintain, and update project records and study designs within Eurofins LIMS, CRM platforms, and other designated systems.
Coordinate project startup activities, ensuring required methods, materials, specifications, and documentation are available prior to project initiation.
Serve as a primary point of contact for routine client communication and provide timely project updates.
Schedule and coordinate project activities with laboratory operations, quality assurance, sample administration, finance, business development, and other supporting departments.
Monitor project timelines, deliverables, and action items to help ensure commitments are met.
Track project scope changes and assist with change-order documentation and approvals when needed.
Support invoice review activities and assist with the resolution of routine billing questions.
Escalate project risks, delays, or issues to appropriate stakeholders and support resolution efforts.
Maintain organized, accurate, and traceable project documentation throughout the project lifecycle.
Participate in team cross-training and provide coverage support as needed.
Ensure all work is performed in accordance with company procedures, quality standards, and client requirements.

Qualifications

Basic Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Chemistry, Biology, Biochemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, Life Sciences, or a related scientific field.
Minimum of 2 years of professional experience in a scientific, laboratory, client service, project coordination, or related environment.
Strong organizational, communication, and time-management skills.
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
Authorization to work in the United States indefinitely without restriction or sponsorship.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience coordinating projects, studies, or client deliverables in a laboratory, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, CRO, or related scientific environment.
Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
Experience working with LIMS, eLIMS, eQMS, eQMS/ETQ, CRM systems, or other laboratory software platforms.
Strong problem-solving, data review, and organizational skills.
Ability to collaborate effectively across multiple departments and levels of an organization.
Knowledge of regulated laboratory environments is preferred.

Additional Information

Schedule:
Full-Time, Monday-Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 4:30 p.m., with overtime as needed.

Candidates currently living within a commutable distance of Columbia, MO are encouraged to apply.

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Company-paid life and disability insurance
401(k) with company match
Paid vacation and holidays
Opportunities for professional growth and development within a global organization
